# Translator

> Agent-operated translated captions and bounded PC audio sharing.

Start with `uv run --locked translator agent catalog --command runtime-start`.
Read one command at a time; omit `--command` only when the full catalog is needed.
Use an explicit data directory. Read `ok` before continuing. Session IDs come from results.
